title: Appeal

replies.author: rinn
replies.body:
Hello,

I have decided to deny your appeal for the following reason(s):
- You have accumulated over 25 infractions leading up to your temporary ban, which shows that you did not learn from your previous infractions, and continued to break rules.
- As your ban is valid, the Senior Staff team has no reason to appeal your punishment, and you will have to wait for your ban to expire.

Regards,
Rinn
Avicus Network Senior Moderator
